units: <cite ref="Shabbat 66b:14">Sabb. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>כי היכי דציל הא מישחא לֵיצִיל וכ׳</he> as this oil is clear, so may the wine of—be clear (that our minds may not be affected by the wine); <cite ref="Shabbat 66b:14">ib.</cite> <he>כי היכי דצִילָא האי שיעתא ליציל וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>דליציל האי שיעא</he> read: <he>דציל</he>; Ms. O. <he>דצאיל</he>) as this sealing clay is bright, so may the wine &c.

<cite ref="Eruvin 64a:7">Erub. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>לא צילא דעתאי</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>צִילָאִי</he>; Yalk. Noah Ms. <he>צָאִילְנָא</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 70) my mind is not clear (I am not clear in my mind).
<cite ref="Pesachim 110b:6">Pes. 110ᵇ</cite> <he>הוה צייל וכ׳</he> he remained clear in his mind, and was on his guard.
<cite ref="Shabbat 23a:4">Sabb. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>ציל נהוריה טפי</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="R00518"><he>צליל</he></cite>) its light is brighter.
<cite ref="Chullin 55b:5">Ḥull. 55ᵇ</cite> <he>דצִילֵי</he> when the fluid in the ulcers is clear, opp. <he>עכירי</he>.
<cite ref="Gittin 70b:4">Gitt. 70ᵇ</cite> <he>לכי מִתְצִיל לא וכ׳</he> when he is rational again, he need not retract what he said when delirious.
